vulnerable.evidence: Unsigned token accepted with falsy key and default algorithms

fixed.evidence: Unsigned token was rejected when verified with falsy key

oracle.explanation: Validates normal HS256 sign/verify first, then exercises CVE-2022-23540 by verifying an unsigned (alg none) token with a falsy verification key and no algorithms option. Vulnerable jsonwebtoken (<=8.5.1) accepts it; patched versions reject unless none is explicitly allowed.
